# e2b_lifecycle_webhook (Resource)

Manages an E2B sandbox lifecycle webhook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "e2b_webhook_signature_secret" {
  description = "Secret E2B uses to sign lifecycle webhook payloads."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

resource "e2b_lifecycle_webhook" "audit" {
  name             = "terraform-audit"
  url              = "https://example.com/e2b/lifecycle"
  enabled          = true
  signature_secret = var.e2b_webhook_signature_secret
  events           = ["sandbox.started", "sandbox.paused", "sandbox.killed"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Lifecycle webhook name.
- `signature_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret E2B uses to sign webhook payloads.
- `url` (String) HTTPS endpoint that receives lifecycle events.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether E2B should deliver events to the webhook.
- `events` (Set of String) Lifecycle event names delivered to the webhook.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the webhook was created.
- `id` (String) Lifecycle webhook ID.
- `team_id` (String) E2B team ID that owns the webhook.
